working_title: Which Rainforest Animal Can Help? | Golden Seed Guessing Adventure
one_message: Animal body features help each friend solve a different part of one shared rainforest mission.
creative_intent: Turn four animal-trait guesses into one continuous golden-seed relay with an earned planting payoff, never a card quiz or slideshow.
visual_system: integrated full-frame cinematic 3D storybook rainforest with persistent seed, leaf satchel and route continuity
interaction_style: observe the physical obstacle, hear one trait clue, predict during a quiet hold, then watch the animal perform the answer

motion_language.easing: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) for animal landings; smooth ease-in-out for travel
motion_language.transition_family: clean motivated cuts and short foreground leaf wipes only; never dissolve character poses
motion_language.motion_intensity: one generous hero action with restrained secondary follow-through
hierarchy: hero: the helper animal's physical action or the moving golden seed
support: Miki marmoset reacts and passes the persistent leaf satchel
texture: water, leaves, insects and light move slowly at low contrast
motion_language.restraint: No static choice cards, silhouettes, labels during thinking holds, camera-only scenes, whole-frame wobble, looping text or competing decorative transitions.
motion_language.one_wow_moment: The whole route reconnects in one overhead move before a truthful multi-day sprouting time-lapse.

cast.name: Miki
cast.role: small orange-gold marmoset guide carrying a green leaf satchel

cast.name: Kiko
cast.role: nocturnal canopy balancer with a grasping tail

continuity_rules: The same oval golden seed remains inside or beside the same green leaf satchel in every scene.
Miki retains the same orange-gold fur, cream face, teal neckerchief and small green satchel.
Each obstacle has explicit start, action and end images with object continuity and one changed physical state.
An answer animal is revealed through an action in the environment, never by highlighting a picture choice.
The seed reaches the nursery only after all four helpers contribute in route order.

scenes.name: rolling-seed-hook
scenes.purpose: Begin immediately with one clear problem.
scenes.story_beat: A golden seed rolls from Miki's satchel toward a rain-swollen stream; Miki catches it on a broad leaf and sees the nursery marker across the rainforest.
scenes.primary_action: seed rolls, Miki lunges, broad leaf catches it

scenes.name: capybara-river-crossing
scenes.question: Which friend lives beside water and can swim the leaf boat safely across?
scenes.fact: Capybaras are strong swimmers and can keep much of their body low in the water.
scenes.primary_action: Cora enters the water, nudges the leaf boat through the current and lands it on the opposite bank

scenes.name: armadillo-leaf-channel
scenes.question: Which friend has strong front claws that can clear a shallow path through loose leaves?
scenes.fact: Armadillos use powerful claws for digging.
scenes.primary_action: Arlo rakes loose leaves aside, exposing a safe narrow path around a fallen branch

scenes.name: sloth-branch-pass
scenes.question: Which friend can hang from a branch and carry the satchel slowly across the gap?
scenes.fact: Three-toed sloths use long curved claws to hang securely from branches.
scenes.primary_action: Sela hooks onto the branch, carries the satchel across and lowers it gently to Miki

scenes.name: kinkajou-dusk-balance
scenes.question: Which night-time friend can balance in the canopy with a grasping tail?
scenes.fact: Kinkajous are nocturnal climbers with prehensile tails that can grip branches.
scenes.primary_action: Kiko grips a branch with the tail, crosses the last canopy bend and passes the satchel to Miki at the nursery

scenes.name: plant-and-time-lapse-finale
scenes.purpose: Resolve the mission truthfully and celebrate every contribution.
scenes.story_beat: Miki plants the seed with all four helpers; several sun-and-moon cycles pass, rain waters the soil and a small healthy sprout emerges.
scenes.primary_action: route reconnects overhead, seed is planted, weather/time passes, sprout opens two leaves

quality_gates: single Natasha voice for every spoken line
all narration finishes inside its matching visual shot
no line exceeds 118 weighted words per minute
minimum half-second gaps between spoken lines
5 to 7 second silent prediction hold in all four guessing scenes
explicit start/action/end state for every helper scene
actual foreground action, never camera-only motion
no pose dissolves or ghosted limbs
continuous visual timeline with zero gaps or overlaps
H.264 1920x1080 video and 48 kHz stereo AAC
opening hiss measurement below the project ceiling
final card is the final event only
custom thumbnail is manually reviewed before any queue release
upload_authorized remains false until the user reviews the finished local master
